caption: The video captures a dance studio with a parquet floor, a mirror wall, a frosted window, and a round wall clock on the right. A man in a black sleeveless top and pants stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, facing the mirror, where his reflection mirrors his movements. He runs a rhythmic routine, repeatedly lifting one knee off the floor and returning both feet between cycles. As each knee rises, his arms sweep from bent positions at his chest out to the sides, one arm lifting overhead before lowering. The mirror reflects other people standing back, including figures in teal, yellow, and white, who also gesture with their arms in rhythm. The camera and room fixtures remain fixed, holding constant positions across the frames. The routine is already in progress when the clip opens and continues through its end. The differing opening and closing poses mark this as a cropped excerpt.
